measurements.evidence_quote: Surface charge analysis via zeta potential (Figure 4) supported the chemical changes, showing increased negative surface potential with aging. Measurements were performed on particle suspensions in 1 mM KCl (pH adjusted with HCl/NaOH, 2 min equilibration) at a concentration of 0.1 mg/mL, following established protocols for colloidal systems [18]. || Surface charge (zeta potential) was measured with a Litesizer 500 (Anton Paar, Graz, Austria) on fine particulate fractions suspended in 1 mM KCl [18].
